purpose: Teach: 炊い/吹き出し/バリア/しびれ/丸め/きれる/集まら/すりゃ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お米、絶対、上手に、絶対、炊いた、絶対、よ
lines.en: Sho, I made the rice really perfectly today, you know.
lines.style: Warm, pleased tone without boasting. Gentle emphasis on the accomplishment. Soft, affectionate. The voice of someone proud to share something good with someone she cares about.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、漫画の、絶対、吹き出し、絶対、ぼく、絶対、描いてみたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis! I tried drawing the speech bubbles in my manga, look!
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery. Quick tempo. Open attack on the first word—wanting to show her something. Genuine excitement, not performed. The energy of a kid who wants someone he trusts to see what he made.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんと、本気で、絶対、翔くん、絶対、バリア、絶対、なくて、絶対、なんでも、絶対、お話できるね
lines.en: With you, Sho, there's no barrier between us. I can talk to you about anything.
lines.style: Quiet realization underneath warmth. Tender pace. Slight pause before 'anything'—the weight of meaning it. Steady, intimate eye contact level. Soft trailing at the end, like a small gift being offered.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、長く、絶対、お座りすると、絶対、ぼく、絶対、足が、絶対、しびれる、絶対、よ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my legs fall asleep when I sit with you for too long, you know.
lines.style: Wry observation with genuine affection underneath. Matter-of-fact delivery, but with a small smile in the voice. No complaint—just noticing something true. Slight humor on the word 'asleep.'

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お肉、絶対、丸めて、絶対、お団子、絶対、作ったわ、翔くん
lines.en: I rolled the meat and made little dumplings for us, Sho.
lines.style: Animated but not frantic. Light, pleased energy. Tempo quick enough to convey the small joy of doing something nice. The voice of someone showing off in the gentlest way—this is what I made for you.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、よく、絶対、切れる、絶対、よくきれる、絶対、はさみ、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、もらったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got these really sharp scissors from Dad!
lines.style: Pride tempered with careful respect for the sharp thing he's holding. Eager to tell her about this gift. Natural child-like emphasis on 'really sharp.' Small pause before 'from Dad'—importance of where it came from.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お友達、絶対、集まらない、絶対、日も、絶対、楽しめるわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Even when your friends can't come over, Sho, we can still have fun together.
lines.style: Reflective, reassuring tone. Slower pace. The voice reaching for something gentle—she's noticing he might worry about missing things, and she's saying that's okay. Warm underlying the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、宿題、絶対、すりゃ、絶対、お母さんも、絶対、喜ぶよね
lines.en: If you just do your homework, Sho, your mom will be happy too, won't she.
lines.style: Gentle encouragement with quiet sincerity. Soft emphasis on 'just do'—making it simple and possible. The affectionate voice of someone who notices what would matter to someone else and says it without pressure.
